title: Interatrial shunts
scope: Generic class mechanism in representative anatomy. The anatomy, device shape and positions shown are representative of this class; they are not measured on a specific patient or population, and not a specific product. Schematic, not to scale; poses do not predict clinical fit, deformation, performance or flow.
stageLabel: Schematic · representative anatomy · not to scale
attribution: Whole-heart context adapted from Toronto Heart Atlas by Azad Mashari, Joshua Qua Hiansen, Mini Pakkal, Eitan Aziza, Ryan Ramos, Sachin Khargie and Massimiliano Meineri (CC BY 4.0). Display smoothing, vessel continuations and edits for readability are modifications. Detailed tissue shells, defects, device shapes and positions are representative schematics. They are not measured on a specific patient or population, and are not segmented tissue or clinical simulations.

designs.label: Interatrial shunt
designs.summary: A generic flared channel that keeps an opening through a representative atrial septum.

states.label: 1. Anatomy only
states.note: An enlarged representative section; dimensions and tissue shapes are not measured on a specific patient or population.

states.label: 2. Compact illustration
states.note: A simplified narrow device pose, not a delivery instruction or a simulated deployment.

states.label: 3. Expanded illustration
states.note: A representative expanded pose. Contact, sealing, tissue deformation and flow are not calculated.

views.label: Whole heart
views.title: Locate the region
views.lesson: The enlarged marker orients the separate representative diagrams.

views.label: Atria and septum
views.title: See the channel site on the real atrial septum
views.lesson: Both atria come from a real heart model with walls added, opened from the front through the two caval veins. The channel sits on the wall shared by the two atria, where the oval fossa would lie. The position of the opening is representative and is not measured on a specific patient or population.

views.label: Tissue section
views.title: See both sides of the tissue
views.lesson: An interatrial shunt preserves a channel; unlike the occluder illustrations, its center is not filled by a closure disc.

views.label: Oblique detail
views.title: See the three-dimensional relationship
views.lesson: A representative oblique view separates the near and far components.

views.label: Face view
views.title: Look toward the channel
views.lesson: Use this complementary view to distinguish tissue, the device and the opening.

location.label: TREATMENT LOCATION
location.body: The highlighted region locates this class in the heart. The marker is enlarged for orientation.

wall.label: SEPTAL TISSUE
wall.body: The thick wall separates the two sides. Its shape and thickness are representative.

channel.label: PRESERVED CHANNEL
channel.body: The central lumen remains open through the illustrated device. No flow direction, pressure effect or clinical response is represented.

flare.label: FLARED ENDS
flare.body: The generic flared ends lie on opposing faces of the representative septum, around an open channel.

compact.label: COMPACT POSE
compact.body: The narrow illustration contrasts with the expanded pose; a sheath and delivery sequence are omitted.

region_RA.label: RIGHT ATRIUM
region_RA.body: The right atrium is opened from the front. The two caval veins open into it above and below the septum.

region_LA.label: LEFT ATRIUM
region_LA.body: The left atrium lies behind the septum. Its back wall carries the openings of the lung veins.

region_SVC.label: UPPER CAVAL VEIN
region_SVC.body: The upper caval vein opens into the top of the right atrium, above the septum.

region_IVC.label: LOWER CAVAL VEIN
region_IVC.body: The lower caval vein opens into the bottom of the right atrium, below the septum.

region_septum.label: INTERATRIAL SEPTUM
region_septum.body: The cut edge shows the thin wall shared by the two atria. Around it, the atrial walls fold away from each other, so the flat part of the septum is limited.

region_communication.label: CHANNEL SITE
region_communication.body: A round opening through the septum, placed where the oval fossa would lie. The position of the opening is representative and is not measured on a specific patient or population.

region_device.label: GENERIC OPEN SHUNT
region_device.body: The generic device sits in the opening, with a flared end on each face of the septum and an open channel through its middle. Its shape and size are representative and do not represent a specific product.
